# Werkstadt

> Werkstadt is a Claude Code visualizer: a local, open-source (Apache-2.0) tool that reads the session transcripts Claude Code already writes to `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` and renders them as a 3D world you can fly through — a planet of every project, an island per project, and one coding session as a walkable city where each street is a session and each building is a file. It runs entirely on the user's own machine (Python standard library server bound to 127.0.0.1), with no account, no telemetry, and an optional pseudonymization mode for screenshots and recordings.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) so language models and AI agents can find the right page for a given question without crawling the whole repository.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, the three views, screenshots, configuration reference
- [How it works](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md): the server, the event schema, every `/api/*` endpoint
- [Release notes](docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md): what shipped in 0.1.0 and its known limits
- [Runbook](docs/RUNBOOK.md): running it at login on Windows, macOS and Linux

## Install

- [30-second install](README.md#install-in-30-seconds): `git clone`, fetch the asset library, `python server.py` — Python 3.9+, no `pip install`, no build step
- [Claude Code plugin](README.md#as-a-claude-code-plugin): `/plugin marketplace add beriki770-ship-it/werkstadt`
- [Latest release](https://github.com/beriki770-ship-it/werkstadt/releases/latest): source archive and the CC0 asset zip

## Privacy

- [Privacy section](README.md#privacy): binds to 127.0.0.1 only, reads transcripts read-only, no upload, no account, no telemetry
- Redaction mode (`--redact` or `"redact": true`) replaces every project name, session title, file path and agent tag with a stable pseudonym before it leaves the server
